title: Dilation of a varifold given by a fibrewise H^n-representation
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and let C be an n-varifold on ℝ^N (U = ℝ^N). Let M ⊆ ℝ^N, let P be a relation between points x ∈ ℝ^N and n-planes T ∈ G(N,n), and let g : ℝ^N → [0,∞]. Assume that for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^N × G(N,n), C(A) = ∫⁻ over {x : x ∈ M ∧ ∃ T, P(x,T) ∧ (x,T) ∈ A} of g dH^n, with H^n = μHE[n]. Then for every s > 0 and every Borel A, (η_{0,s#}C)(A) = rescaledMeasure C 0 s A = ∫⁻ over {w : s·w ∈ M ∧ ∃ T, P(s·w,T) ∧ (w,T) ∈ A} of g(s·w) dH^n(w). Here rescaledMeasure C 0 s = ofReal(s⁻¹^n) • (C.measure pushed forward by z ↦ (s⁻¹•(z.1 − 0), z.2)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (P : Euclidean N → Grassmannian N n → Prop) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → C.measure A = ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, P x T ∧ (x, T) ∈ A}, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → rescaledMeasure C 0 s A = ∫⁻ w in {w : Euclidean N | s • w ∈ M ∧ ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, P (s • w) T ∧ (w, T) ∈ A}, g (s • w) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
